feb23b.text:
Most of your visitors hold their phone in one hand.
So try the thumb test on your own website:

01 Tap-to-call within thumb reach
02 Buttons about a fingertip wide
03 Text readable without pinching or zooming
04 Short forms: name, phone, message

On the Techfahm site we built, the main "Book a free consultation" button sits right in the thumb zone.

Grab your phone and check yours today. How many of the 4 does it pass?
